# aembit_resource_set (Resource)

Resource to create and manage Resource Sets in an Aembit Cloud tenant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the ResourceSet.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the ResourceSet.
- `roles` (Set of String) IDs of the Roles associated with this Resource Set. Aembit automatically assigns the tenant's SuperAdmin and Auditor roles to every Resource Set. If omitted or null, Terraform populates this attribute with those default system role IDs. If set to an explicit set of custom role IDs or an empty set ([]), Terraform tracks only the configured role IDs in this attribute while exposing the full backend-assigned set (including SuperAdmin and Auditor) in effective_roles.
- `standalone_certificate_authority` (String) Standalone Certificate Authority ID configured for this ResourceSet.

### Read-Only

- `effective_roles` (Set of String) Complete set of Role IDs in effect for this Resource Set, including system-assigned roles (SuperAdmin and Auditor) and any configured custom roles.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the ResourceSet.
